records.text: Shade of Akama is the hostile shade Akama must overcome to reclaim control of his soul. Defeating the Shade inside the Black Temple is part of Akama’s secret effort against Illidan.
The Ashtongue Battlelord is a close-range fighter who uses Cleave and Concussion Blow. Its enraged warning marks a battle fought with force and aggression.
The Ashtongue Mystic is a combat spellcaster whose use of a Cyclone Totem gives this mystic a battlefield role distinct from a close-range fighter.
The Ashtongue Stormcaller fights with lightning magic, using Chain Lightning and Lightning Bolt. These spells define this stormcaller’s ranged combat role.
The Ashtongue Primalist is a ranged fighter in the Black Temple who looses volleys of Multi-Shot.
Storm Fury is a storm-borne creature of the Black Temple that blinks across the battlefield.
The Ashtongue Feral Spirit charges into battle with Charge Rage.
The Illidari Defiler is an Illidari fighter in the Black Temple who can banish a foe.
The Illidari Nightlord terrifies foes with Fear and scorches them with Shadow Inferno.
The Reliquary of the Lost is a single, powerful presence in the Black Temple.
An Illidari Boneslicer fights with Wound Poison and Gouge, weakening and disabling opponents in close combat.

Teron Gorefiend speaks as one long returned from death: he says the wheel has spun many times and he has much time to make up. Vengeance drives him; he taunts his foes and demands their respect, while hinting at darker purposes for them.
A Coilskar General enters battle with a booming voice, marked by a spell that carries its authority into the fight.
A Coilskar Harpooner fights at range, hurling a spear at its opponent.
A Coilskar Sea-Caller brings storm magic into battle, striking foes with Forked Lightning and Hurricane.
A Coilskar Soothsayer supports wounded allies, using Restoration when a friendly creature is missing health.
A Coilskar Wrangler is a combatant whose fighting style includes a cleaving strike.
An Aqueous Lord is an elemental combatant that attacks with a crashing wave.
A Shadowmoon Reaver is a combatant who uses spell absorption in battle.
A Shadowmoon Champion is a combatant who attacks with chaotic light and a whirling blade.
An Aqueous Surger is an elemental combatant whose attacks include a poison bolt volley.
A Shadowmoon Deathshaper wraps itself in demon armor before battle and hurls shadow bolts.
Aqueous Spawn is an elemental that fights with Sludge Nova and can merge with others.
Leviathan is a beast that attacks with a debilitating spray and poison spit.
A dragon turtle kept as a Coilskar Harpooner's pet, it defends itself by spitting water.
A captive held in the Black Temple.

High Warlord Naj'entus is a Black Temple warlord who declares he fights in Lady Vashj's name and warns that Lord Illidan will crush challengers. His combat taunts show impatience and confidence, including a threat to deal with an opponent later and a boast that their success was short-lived.

Supremus is a demon of the Black Temple who changes his target, punches the ground in anger, cracks the earth open, and flies into a berserker rage. These are announced as events rather than spoken words.

Illidan Stormrage, the Betrayer, faces Akama’s planned assault in the Black Temple sanctum. He calls on his minions to punish a traitor, taunts attackers as fearful and powerless, dismisses them as rabble, and asks who will be next to face his blades.
Temple Concubines are humanoids of the Black Temple who strike with a Love Tap and can polymorph a foe.
Shadowmoon Blood Mages are humanoid combatants found in the Black Temple. They attack with Bloodbolt.
Shadowmoon War Hounds are beasts of the Black Temple.
Mother Shahraz uses teasing, flirtatious taunts to unsettle opponents, mixing playful questions with dismissive remarks and sharp threats.
Gurtogg Bloodboil is a ravenous, brutal combatant who claims the Horde will crush his foes and speaks of feasting on their flesh, demanding more as he fights.
Gathios the Shatterer is an impatient, threatening combatant who dismisses opponents' efforts, tells them to enjoy their final moments, and claims them as his own.
High Nethermancer Zerevor is a spellcaster who openly calls Common a crude language. His other short utterances are delivered in a different tongue.
Lady Malande is a combatant loyal to Quel'Thalas and the Sunwell. She warns enemies to flee or die, insists there are no second chances, and declares herself full of surprises.

Veras Darkshadow is a named fighter in the council encounter. In battle, Veras challenges opponents, answers pressure with defiance, and praises kills, giving the combatant a taunting, self-assured presence.
Wrathbone Flayer is an undead fighter who cleaves its foes.
A demon Illidari Fearbringer that burns foes with Illidari Flames and stomps them.
A charming courtesan who can infatuate foes and lays frost traps.
A demon Sister of Pain who lashes foes and curses them with Shadow Word: Pain.
A demon priestess who confuses foes and sows dementia.
A spellbound attendant can disrupt a spellcaster with a kick when its target begins casting.
A Dragonmaw Wyrmcaller is a field scout, ordered to watch the area and report anything it sees.
Known as the Priestess of Delight, she is a combatant who uses Curse of Vitality during a fight.
Bonechewer Workers proclaim, “The blood is our power!” Their other cries are “Gakarah ma!” and “Lok narash!” They throw picks at their foes.
A demon known as a Sister of Pleasure.
An enslaved servant forced into service, who fights with uppercuts and kidney shots.

Shadowmoon Houndmasters serve as armed combatants in the Black Temple. This one uses a bow and can summon a riding warhound when engaged, while its other recorded tactics include Volley and Freezing Trap.
Bonechewer Taskmasters spur fel orcs into battle with taunts about their fighting and threats of labor among the drake stalls. Their combat role is to pressure fighters to keep attacking.
Dragonmaw Sky Stalkers are armed combatants who call dragonriders to mount up and joke about buzzing the tower. In battle, this one also uses a bow.
Shadowmoon Soldiers answer their commander with “Yes Sir!” and use drill calls such as “Hut!” and “Hoo-rah!” Their short responses and combat training mark them as disciplined rank-and-file troops.

Shadowmoon Weapon Masters call out Battle, Berserker, and Defensive Stances, directing fighters to rush, attack recklessly, or shield themselves and strike back. Their recorded combat behavior includes entering Battle Stance.
An invisible stalker found in the Black Temple.
A sewer rat in the Black Temple.
A sewer crocolisk in the Black Temple.

At the Black Temple, Akama leads allies against Illidan, whom he calls the Betrayer, seeking freedom for his people and Outland and redemption for his people. He warns allies of Illidan ahead and says he will lead them onward once they have recovered their strength. He also admits he cannot do it alone.
A Shadowmoon Grunt is a humanoid.
Aluyen sells reagents in the Black Temple.

Seer Kanai speaks for Akama's campaign against Illidan in the Black Temple, asking willing fighters to help. He describes Akama's secret plan to free his soul and strike Illidan, a move whose failure would be catastrophic for the Broken and all Outland; the resistance must act without knowing what became of Maiev. He greets visitors with a brief “Yes?”
Okuno is the Ashtongue Deathsworn quartermaster, offering goods and repairs. His title identifies his supply role.
The Hand of Gorefiend is a humanoid that casts Enrage when its health is low.

At the Black Temple, Akama identifies himself as leader of the Ashtongue Broken. He tells allies that his tribe’s future depends on their fight against Illidan’s grasp. He declares the Betrayer’s magic over the Ashtongue soul destroyed and urges his people to shed their chains and take up arms against their Illidari masters. He frames their freedom as a reason to confront their true enemy.
A hulking Bonechewer combatant that charges nearby targets and can become enraged in a fight.
A Bonechewer brawler who fights for sport: badly hurt, it may cry "I submit!" or praise a "Good fight!" It grows frenzied at low health and can fly into a rage.
A Bonechewer spectator at the arena cheers on the fighting, urging combatants to kill and praising a final blow while dismissing weak attacks.
A mutated war hound that attacks with a cloud of disease.
A Bonechewer Blade Fury grows impatient with waiting and hungers to feed. It imagines the Bonechewers ruling the dark temple one day, and fights with a whirlwind attack.
A Bonechewer shield disciple shares the faction’s hunger, impatience and ambition to rule the dark temple. It fights by throwing its shield.
A Bonechewer Blood Prophet is impatient to feed and dreams that the Bonechewers will one day rule the dark temple. It fights with blood bolts and drains its foes' blood.
A Bonechewer combatant treats a fight as a contest: after submitting, it says the victory is only for now, and can also commend a good fight.
A Dragonmaw Wind Reaver is a Dragonmaw fighter whose cries, “Permission to buzz the tower!” and “Dragonriders mount up!”, evoke the faction's mounted air assault. It hurls fireballs.
Illidari Centurions are heavily armed soldiers serving the Illidari, who cleave their foes.
Illidari Heartseekers are Illidari combatants. Their attacks include Shoot and Skeleton Shot, suggesting ranged attackers.
A humanoid Ashtongue Stalker of the Black Temple.
Promenade Sentinels are magical guards of the Black Temple that strike with arcane charges.
An Illidari Blood Lord is an Illidari combatant. In battle, it uses Hammer of Justice.
An Angered Soul Fragment is a soul fragment consumed by anger that lashes out in fury.
A Suffering Soul Fragment is an undead soul fragment that attacks with Soul Blast.
An Illidari Archon is an Illidari combatant. It takes on Shadowform when engaged and can cast Heal during battle.
A Hungering Soul Fragment is a soul fragment in the Black Temple area.
An Illidari Battle-mage is an Illidari combatant.
An Illidari assassin in the Black Temple who poisons foes with paralyzing venom.
Udalo is a spirit in the temple who tells Akama he is not alone. He says his powers can take visitors deeper once the halls are cleared, and offers passage to the Chamber of Command.
Olum is a spirit connected to the temple and its Deathsworn brethren. He reassures his people that they remain with him, and speaks of a powerful presence guarding the way forward.
An Ashtongue Channeler is a humanoid in the Black Temple.

place_records.text: You are in the Black Temple, set in the Ruins of Karabor in Shadowmoon Valley. Illidan Stormrage, the Betrayer, holds it, and High Warlord Naj'entus is among its masters. Charming courtesans, temple concubines and Bonechewer workers fill its halls. Akama is still struggling to win back his soul from the Shade of Akama inside.

You are in the Illidari Training Grounds of the Black Temple. The demon Supremus stands here among Bonechewer workers and taskmasters, Dragonmaw wyrmcallers and wind reavers, and Illidari fearbringers.
